title: Duke's and Sonny Greer's memory for faces and tunes
summary: Bigard says Duke had a phenomenal memory and so could Sonny Greer, who would remind him who visitors at the Cotton Club were.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: And you're talking about a man that can remember tunes of the past years and people of the past years. He had that memory. He was phenomenal. I've never seen anybody like that.

Another guy like that is Sonny Greer if he's straight. He could remember, because people used to come in the Cotton Club all the time and talk to Duke and Duke would say, "Who's that, Sonny?" And he say, "Don't you remember him? That's so and so from so and so." He said, "Oh, yeah."
